description: POI category names follow the rules locale of the map (fr_FR) (#25941). A French phrase is a category only as a whole: 'Paris' is the city and its places, not a word of 'Preneur de paris' (bookmaker), which still finds the bookmakers. English stays for every map ('Bank'); German 'Kino' and Galician 'Billa' (water tap, 5 taps in the extract) name nothing.
